newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka suffered a major loss in interbank trading on Wednesday amid tight selling of dollar by state-owned banks against a heavy demand.
Dealers said the taka closed at 44.2200/2300 per dollar against Tuesday's close at 44.2100/2150.
Dealers at a foreign bank said they made a few small deals at a low of 44.2400/2500 per dollar at one stage.
"There was a real crisis for dollar. There were heavy demands but little supply," said one dealer.
The call money was traded higher at 8.0 to 8.5 percent against the previous day's 7.0-7.5 percent.
